body.name: \mu_{\lambda}
body.type: factorized probability law on raw global signatures
body.def: If \(\lambda\) selects branch \(r\), then \(\mu_{\lambda}(r',\kappa)=\mathbf 1\{r'=r\}\prod_a\lambda_a(\kappa_a)\) on \(\Omega_{G,\mathcal J}\).
body.role: Raw mass law imposed by mutually independent overlapping edge-latent parents.
